departments.name: Fruit & Veg
departments.intro: Fresh fruit and vegetables arrive every day: seasonal European staples next to the everyday basics, and the herbs the deli and café cook with.

departments.name: Deli & Cheese
departments.blurb: Smallgoods sliced to order and a cheese cabinet worth the drive.
departments.intro: Leg ham, prosciutto, salami and sopressa sliced to order, olives and antipasto, and a cheese cabinet that runs from Gruyère and pecorino to halloumi, saganaki and fresh mascarpone.

departments.name: Butcher
departments.intro: Our butchers cut to order: steaks, roasts, chicken, lamb, house-made chevapi and sausages, with advice on what to cook and how.

departments.name: Seafood
departments.blurb: Fresh seafood and oysters by the dozen.
departments.intro: Tasmanian oysters, prawns, salmon, local mussels and whole fish land through the week.

departments.name: Fresh Pasta & Ready Meals
departments.blurb: Handmade pasta and gnocchi, sauces and ready meals.
departments.intro: Pasta and gnocchi are handmade in the market, from the first mix to the final cut. Take home our sauces, lasagne and pizzas, or eat them at the café's gnocchi bar.

departments.name: Bakery & Pastry
departments.intro: Pistachio croissants, cannoli, crostoli, panettone in season and fresh bread, with the imported biscuits and sweets everyone comes back for.

departments.name: Grocery & Imports
departments.blurb: Italian, Greek and European pantry staples.
departments.intro: Pasta, passata, olive oil, coffee, rice, beans and honey from the brands you grew up with: La Molisana, Mutti, Rummo, Kimbo, Lavazza, Illy, Colavita and more.

departments.name: Liquor
departments.blurb: Italian and European wine and liqueurs, in store.
departments.intro: A considered range of Italian and European wine, Lambrusco, Chianti, Pinot Grigio, Amaretto, Limoncino and Frangelico. Available in store only, to customers aged 18 and over.
